No DOI exists and OpenAlex has no record; the arXiv abs page is canonical. VERSION -- 'Submitted on 15 Jul 2025 (v1), last revised 24 Dec 2025 (this version, v3)'. The archived PDF is v3; the year on the card is 2025, the first-posting year, consistent with how the pilot recorded brainwave. LICENCE -- the abs-license block links http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/, i.e. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. This is a Creative Commons licence, not arXiv's default non-exclusive grant, and it permits redistribution with attribution for non-commercial use, so the PDF is archived. The schema vocabulary has no CC-BY-NC-SA token; CC-BY-NC is used as the leading token with the full licence in the qualifier, which the validator accepts by design. ShareAlike note: the licence permits derivative works but requires them to carry the same licence. source.md is a derivative (a format conversion) held as an internal research note and not redistributed on its own, so no licensing action follows, but if any part of source.md were republished the ShareAlike term would attach. EXTRACTION -- markitdown. Single-column preprint in a wide journal-style template; running prose loses inter-word spacing throughout but is otherwise faithful, and the Key Takeaways and Research Gaps sections, which carry almost every claim on the card, are intact and were quoted verbatim from them. md_quality: rough.
